description:
Cast Cliffside Lookout by paying {W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Whenever Cliffside Lookout enters the battlefield, it and Ondu Cleric triggers, causing you to gain at least two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Cliffside Lookout and the Soldier token, adding {1}{W}.
Whenever Cliffside Lookout dies, Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Cliffside Lookout from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
